title: revenexx dashboards.json (v1)
description: Ready-made dashboards an app or Cube offers for the Cockpit home and the Analytics Studio: a grid of widgets, each a KPI tile, a chart or one block lifted from a report. A tenant adds an offered dashboard and can then rearrange it; the file is the starting layout, not a lock. Every widget reads metrics from metrics.json, so a dashboard tile and the report behind it always show the same number.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema for editor validation and autocompletion.

localizableText.description: Operator-facing text. Either a plain string — which the Cockpit shows in every UI language — or a map of BCP-47 language tag to text. 'en' is required and is what the Cockpit falls back to when its UI locale has no entry, so a half-translated file degrades to English rather than to a blank label. Every entry must hold at least one non-blank character.

key.description: Dashboard key, unique within the file.

description.description: What the dashboard is for, shown where a tenant picks it.

widget.description: One tile on a 12-column grid. x + w must not exceed 12; overlapping widgets are pushed down.

y.description: Row the widget starts in, from 0.

type.description: 'kpi' — one metric as a tile (needs `metric`); 'chart' — a metric over time or by a dimension (needs `chart`); 'report_block' — one block of a report (needs `report` and `block`).

metric.description: For a kpi: the metric, from this package's metrics.json or another's as "<app-or-cube>.<metric>".

chart.description: For a chart: what it plots.

by.description: Break down by this dimension instead of over time. Local or "<app-or-cube>.<dimension>".

report.description: For a report_block: the report key, local or "<app-or-cube>.<report>".

block.description: For a report_block: the position of the block in the report's `blocks`, from 0.
